mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at 94 degrees with overcast skies near Badger Ridge Middle School and an elevated air quality index of 59. The moon is in its waxing gibbous phase, though there are no visible ISS passes tonight.

The City of Verona has officially closed the student contest for the November election sticker design. From July 28 to August 7, residents will be able to vote for the best designs created by local students in grades K through 12. Four winning designs will be printed for voters to collect at the polls.

We have a busy schedule! Live music is playing today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out yoga at Insight Wellness, followed by trivia nights and the downtown farmer's market happening throughout the rest of the week.
In a report regarding notable calls for service, on July 13, officers responded to a situation where a vehicle was found stuck on a rock, resulting in the driver being arrested for O-W-I.
Today is the perfect day to stop by for the Oreo Cookie Overload flavor of the day. The store is open until 10:00 PM tonight, giving you plenty of time to satisfy your sweet tooth.
